# engine_vqa: src/engine/video/vqa/ (tools/engine_layout.py).
# Generated by tools/move_engine_files.py; edited by hand from here on.

add_library(engine_vqa STATIC)

file(GLOB ENGINE_VQA_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.cc"
)
list(FILTER ENGINE_VQA_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "_test(_util)?\\.cc$")

file(GLOB ENGINE_VQA_HEADERS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.h"
)

target_sources(engine_vqa PRIVATE
        ${ENGINE_VQA_SOURCES}
)

target_sources(engine_vqa PUBLIC
        FILE_SET HEADERS
        BASE_DIRS ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src
        FILES ${ENGINE_VQA_HEADERS}
)

find_package(SDL2 REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(engine_vqa
        PUBLIC engine_stream engine_codec SDL2::SDL2 absl::core_headers
        PRIVATE absl::check absl::log
)

# Tests
include(Testing)
add_gtest(
        NAME engine_vqa_test
        SOURCES adpcm_decoders_test.cc audio_output_test.cc audio_ring_test.cc chunk_reader_test.cc
            frame_ring_test.cc lcw_buffer_test.cc movie_clock_test.cc movie_drawer_test.cc
            movie_loader_test.cc movie_test.cc vq_decoder_test.cc vqa_player_test.cc
        LIBS engine_vqa
)
